diet noun

classical

Traupman 63: vīctūs ratiō, a diet; vīctūs ratiōnem observāre, to diet

1vīctus: long i (Lewis & Short leaves it unmarked). The ī is hidden; marked long as in vīxī, vīctum.

vīctus1, vīctūs m.

noun, fourth declension

diet, way of eating

Other words

    also used · classical · Cic. Fin. 2.90: tenuissimō vīctū

  • diaeta, diaetae f. — a prescribed regimen

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · M-O
